_comment: The pension case types, one list for the whole system (29 Sep 2026). The eleven types are the columns of the AG office's 'Pension Case Document Requirements' sheet (Document Checklist.pdf in the project root), in the sheet's order; each is also the office checklist column the case runs on (rules/checklist.py) and maps to the pipeline path(s) the rules classify by ('pipeline_types'; empty means any, as for a revision). rules/case_type.py derives its tables from this file and the portal imports it, so the two cannot drift.

case_types.label: Fresh – Self
case_types.hint: The government servant's own pension on retirement, superannuation or retiring; sanction on Form B-I.

case_types.label: Fresh – Invalid
case_types.hint: Retirement on medical grounds or as a penalty; sanction on Form B-IV with the medical certificate.

case_types.label: Revised
case_types.hint: Revision of a pension already sanctioned, on the order of retirement, obituary, death or revision.

case_types.label: Death during service
case_types.hint: The government servant died while still in service; sanction on Form D-I.

case_types.label: Widow / Widower
case_types.hint: A pensioner has died; the widow or widower claims the family pension on Form D-II.

case_types.label: Unmarried daughter / son
case_types.hint: A pensioner has died; an unmarried daughter or son claims on Form D-II.

case_types.label: Widowed daughter
case_types.hint: A pensioner has died; a widowed daughter claims on Form D-II.

case_types.label: Divorced daughter
case_types.hint: A pensioner has died; a divorced daughter claims on Form D-II.

case_types.label: Disabled son / daughter / sister
case_types.hint: A pensioner has died; a disabled son, daughter or sister claims on Form D-II, with the medical certificate.

case_types.label: Parent
case_types.hint: A pensioner has died; a parent claims on Form D-II.

case_types.label: Unmarried / widowed / divorced sister
case_types.hint: A pensioner has died; an unmarried, widowed or divorced sister claims on Form D-II.

_pipeline_comment: The paths the rules classify a bundle by (BRAIN §4), with the PSA form that settles each. What the AI reads a case as is one of these; the office types above map onto them.

pipeline_types.label: Family pension — death of a pensioner
